about.heading: How I work
about.summary: Outside the classroom I set up servers for fun and run my own services — notes, movies and P2P communication — all self-hosted. I work with a method: plan first, follow it step by step, and debug and adjust at the end of each phase before moving on. Dog lover.

values.title: Self-hosting by default
values.body: I run and maintain my own services on hardware I administer, treating them like real production.

values.title: Method over speed
values.body: Plan first, then step by step, debugging at the close of every phase.

values.title: Documented and organized
values.body: Clean, documented, predictable work beats clever shortcuts.

skills.title: Technologies I work with

projects.title: Featured work
projects.description: Academic and collaborative projects where I worked across the stack — from resilient microservices to full-stack storefronts.
projects.otherDescription: Personal projects and tools I build and maintain on my own, from a private messaging app to a resume generator.

resilenciaKubernetes.description: Microservices system that tests how an application behaves on Kubernetes when a service fails and how it recovers, built with Python, FastAPI, Docker and Docker Compose.
bullets: I was responsible for generating 50,000 simulated users to test it in near-real conditions, in addition to refactoring and organizing the code, running the resilience tests and documenting observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger and OpenTelemetry.

bookiaStore.description: Online store where users search, consult and buy books, with Angular on the frontend, Node.js on the backend and MySQL for the data.
bullets: Built the frontend structure and navigation, developed the visual components and improved the usability of the purchase process.

ecommerceApi.description: Online store with product catalog and basic purchase flow, with HTML, CSS and JavaScript on the frontend and Node.js, Express and MySQL on the backend.
bullets: Organized the frontend and backend, developed routes and controllers, connected the database and refactored code as a team.

nova.description: Private Discord-style messaging app for two people, in development: 15-day message retention, calls and 1080p60fps screen sharing, built with Electron and a self-hosted server securely exposed with Cloudflare Tunnel.
bullets: Led the entire project: interface, real-time communication and server, developed with an AI agent that I configured and supervised at every stage.

intercambioMagico.description: Secret Santa website with restricted draws: create events, add participants, define who cannot gift whom and run the draw respecting those rules. 100% front-end with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap and localStorage.
bullets: Designed the draw algorithm with exclusions, built the drag & drop interface and implemented data persistence in the browser.

devprofile.description: Web application to create a resume from scratch: edit your data and sections, see the live preview, review your skills in charts and export the result to PDF. Built with React, Vite and Context API.
bullets: Built the editor, the live preview and the PDF export, and deployed the app automatically to GitHub Pages with GitHub Actions.

experience.title: Where I've worked
experience.description: Customer-facing and administrative roles that shaped how I approach process, documentation, and detail.

teleperformance.role: Customer Service Representative · Billing, Sales & Repair
bullets: Managed customer requests across billing, sales, and technical support through internal service platforms.
Handled accounts, invoices, call history, and sensitive data within corporate interfaces.
Tracked cases related to payments, service, and repairs, applying ITIL fundamentals for request handling, incident management, and case follow-up and closure.
Organized and improved internal documentation, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and standardization.
Reviewed data in the product acquisition system, including pricing, records, and information consistency.

education.title: Academic background & certifications
education.description: Training focused on databases (design, normalization and administration) and on deploying web applications with a well-protected backend. Security is emphasized throughout the degree, from development agents to the final services.
